scenario: A completed Russian Process transcript was reopened through the normal translation action with the visible English target selected.

failure_isolation.message: Язык перевода должен отличаться от языка исходной речи.

assertions: The normal bridge route preserves the selected target in both the plan and the spawned job.
The packaged worker executed the requested target and the persisted Integra provenance records requested and executed target language separately.
The reusable source transcript and SRT hashes match the persisted provenance after success and after the rejected target request.
The normal user surface labels the target in Russian and keeps provider metadata out of the primary result card.
limitations: The current Process source-speech contract is Russian-only, so the one currently valid user-visible target is English.
This outcome does not add English source-speech recognition, translated TXT, translated SRT, topic translation, or provider substitutability.
